title: Trustworthy Geospatial AI Workflows: Reproducible Maritime Analytics and Forecasting on Open-Source AIS Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.25884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Publicly available geospatial data provide increasing opportuni- ties for data-driven maritime analytics and predictive modelling. However, their availability does not necessarily imply that the underlying observations are equally suitable for downstream AI applications. Properties of the data source and observation pro- cess, including provenance, reporting regularity, spatial coverage, observation density, and missingness, can affect how geospatial data are interpreted, processed, and ultimately used by predictive models. At the same time, trustworthy geospatial AI requires ana- lytical workflows in which these processing decisions can be made explicit and reproduced. translated_title: 可信地理空间人工智能工作流：基于开源AIS数据的可复现海事分析与预测
translated_abstract: 公开可用的地理空间数据为数据驱动的海事分析与预测建模提供了越来越多的机会。然而，数据的可获得性并不一定意味着底层观测数据同样适用于下游AI应用。数据源与观测过程的特性，包括数据来源、报告规律性、空间覆盖范围、观测密度和缺失情况，会影响地理空间数据的解读与处理方式，并最终影响预测模型对其的使用。与此同时，可信的地理空间AI需要这样的分析工作流：其中这些数据处理决策能够被明确表达并加以复现。本文提出了一个可复现的海事地理空间AI工作流，该工作流围绕damast构建——这是Simula研究实验室开发的一个开源数据处理与机器学习库。以来自多个公共数据提供商的AIS（船舶自动识别系统）观测数据作为案例研究，我们对海事情境下的数据质量与工作流可复现性问题进行了探讨。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于开源数据处理与机器学习库damast的可复现海事地理空间AI工作流，通过系统处理公开AIS数据的数据质量问题，实现可信的海事分析与预测。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a reproducible maritime geospatial AI workflow built on the open-source damast library, enabling trustworthy maritime analytics and forecasting by systematically addressing data quality issues in publicly available AIS data.
